knowledge:
- key_parameters: se=SummarizedExperiment object containing the expression data (counts, abundance, etc.) and sample metadata ;; method=Normalization method ("none", "TMM") in normalizeEdgerCPM or transformation method ("vst", "normTransform", "rlog") in transformDESeq2 ;; scaledAssay=Name of the assay slot to use for clustering, MDS, or PCA (e.g., "vst", "logCPM") ;; colData_id=Column name in colData(se) representing the experimental groups/conditions ;; control=The control group level for differential expression ;; treatment=The treatment group level for differential expression ;; deFun_list=Named list of differential expression functions to run in use_multDE
- alternatives: The package wraps multiple alternative differential expression methods: use_limma_trend, use_limma_voom, use_edgeR_exact, use_edgeR_GLM, use_deseq2, use_DELocal, use_NOIseq, use_EBSeq, and use_SAMseq. Users can choose specific methods or run them all together using use_multDE to compare rankings and results.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for transcriptomics studies where RNA-seq count data needs to be normalized, transformed, visualized, and analyzed for differential expression using multiple standard Bioconductor methods to evaluate and compare their performance.
- pitfalls: For length correction in transformDESeq2(..., method = "normTransform"), the assay name must match with avgTxLength ;; Standard plotMDS from limma does not work with SummarizedExperiment objects, so broadSeq::plot_MDS should be used instead ;; Low expression genes should be filtered out before normalization and differential expression to avoid noise.

workflows.name: rnaseq_analysis_and_comparison
workflows.intent: Perform a complete RNA-seq analysis workflow including normalization, transformation, QC visualization, and comparative differential expression analysis using multiple methods.
input: expression_data.rds (SummarizedExperiment object containing raw counts, abundance, and sample metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and filter low-expression genes ;; 2. Normalize counts (CPM, TMM) using normalizeEdgerCPM ;; 3. Transform counts (VST, normTransform) using transformDESeq2 ;; 4. Visualize sample assays and gene expression using sampleAssay_plot, assay_plot, and genes_plot ;; 5. Perform QC clustering (MDS, Heatmap, PCA) using plot_MDS, plotHeatmapCluster, prcompTidy, plotAnyPC, and biplotAnyPC ;; 6. Perform single-method differential expression using use_NOIseq ;; 7. Perform multi-method differential expression comparison using use_multDE and visualize results using volcanoPlot
workflows.code:
se <- readRDS(system.file("extdata","rat_vole_mouseSE_salmon.rds", package = "broadSeq"))
se$stage <- factor(se$stage,levels = c("Bud","Cap","Late Cap","Bell"))
keep <- (assays(se)[["counts"]] >= 3) %>% rowSums() >= 5 
se <- broadSeq::normalizeEdgerCPM(se ,method = "none",cpm.log = TRUE )
se <- broadSeq::normalizeEdgerCPM(se , method = "TMM", cpm.log = FALSE )
se <- broadSeq::transformDESeq2(se,method = "vst"  )
se <- broadSeq::transformDESeq2(se, method = "normTransform"  )
p <- broadSeq::sampleAssay_plot(se[, se$species=="Mouse" ], assayName = "counts", fill = "stage", yscale = "log2")+ rremove("x.text")
broadSeq::assay_plot(se, feature = c("Shh"), assayNames = c("counts","logCPM","vst","TMM"), x = "stage", fill="species", add="dotplot", palette = "npg")
broadSeq::genes_plot(se, features = c("Shh","Edar"), facet.by = "symbol", x = "stage", assayName = "vst", color="species", palette = "jco")
broadSeq::plot_MDS(se, scaledAssay = "vst", ntop=500, color = "species", shape = "stage", ellipse=TRUE, legend = "bottom")
p_vst <- broadSeq::plotHeatmapCluster(se, scaledAssay = "vst", annotation_col = c("species", "stage"), annotation_row = c("Class","gene_biotype"), ntop = 30, show_geneAs = "symbol", cluster_cols = TRUE, cluster_rows = FALSE, show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = FALSE, main = "Top 30 variable gene vst")
computedPCA_logCPM <- broadSeq::prcompTidy(se, scaledAssay = "logCPM", ntop = 500)
computedPCA_vst <- broadSeq::prcompTidy(se, scaledAssay = "vst", ntop = 500)
plotAnyPC(computedPCA = computedPCA_logCPM, x = 1, y = 2, color = "species", shape = "stage", legend = "bottom")
pca_vst_2_3 <-plotAnyPC(computedPCA = computedPCA_vst, x = 2, y = 3, color = "species", shape = "stage", legend = "bottom")
computedPCA_vst %>% broadSeq::getFeatureLoadRanking(keep = c("symbol","Class")) %>% head()
pca_vst_bi <- broadSeq::biplotAnyPC(computedPCA = computedPCA_vst, x = 1, y = 2, genesLabel = "symbol", color = "species", shape = "stage", legend = "bottom")
result_Noiseq <- use_NOIseq(se = se, colData_id = "stage", control = "Bud", treatment = "Cap", rank = TRUE, r = 10)
funs <- list(limma_trend = use_limma_trend, limma_voom = use_limma_voom, edgeR_exact = use_edgeR_exact, edgeR_glm = use_edgeR_GLM, deseq2 = use_deseq2, DELocal = use_DELocal, noiseq = use_NOIseq, EBSeq = use_EBSeq) 
multi_result <- broadSeq::use_multDE(se = se, deFun_list = funs, return.df = TRUE, colData_id = "stage", control = "Bud", treatment = "Cap", rank = TRUE)
clusters <- multi_result %>% dplyr::select(ends_with("rank")) %>% t() %>% dist() %>% hclust()
plot(clusters,main =  "distance: Euclidean")
multi_result %>% broadSeq::volcanoPlot(pValName = "deseq2_padj", lFCName = "deseq2_log2FoldChange", labelName = "symbol", palette = "lancet" , selectedLabel = multi_result %>% dplyr::arrange(deseq2_padj) %>% pull(symbol) %>% head())
